lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜਗ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਨਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jog jag nihaphal tih maanau jo prabh jas bisaraavai ||1||
lines.translation: Know that Yoga and sacrificial feasts are fruitless, if one forgets the Praises of God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੋਨੋ ਕਉ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan moh dono kau parahar gobi(n)d ke gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: One who lays aside both pride and attachment, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ih bidh ko praanee jeevan mukat kahaavai ||2||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the mortal who does this is said to be 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yet alive. ||2||2||
Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮੈ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa mai bhajan raam ko naahee ||
lines.translation: There is no meditation on the Lord within him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਯਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tih nar janam akaarath khoiaa yah raakhahu man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: That man wastes his life uselessly - keep this in mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath karai brat phun raakhai nah manooaa bas jaa ko ||
lines.translation: He bathes at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and adheres to fasts, but he has no control over his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਤ ਮੈ ਯਾ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nihaphal dharam taahi tum maanahu saach kahat mai yaa kau ||1||
lines.translation: Know that such religion is useless to him. I speak the Truth for his sake. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਹਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਭੇਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise paahan jal mahi raakhio bhedai naahi tih paanee ||
lines.translation: It's like a stone, kept immersed in water; still, the water does not penetrate it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taise hee tum taahi pachhaanahu bhagat heen jo praanee ||2||
lines.translation: So, understand it: that mortal being who lacks devotional worship is just like that. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਯਹ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal mai mukat naam te paavat gur yah bhed bataavai ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, liberation comes from the Naam. The Guru has revealed this secret.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਗਰੂਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak soee nar garooaa jo prabh ke gun gaavai ||3||3||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, he alone is a great man, who sings the Praises of God. ||3||3||
Bilaaval, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, Tenth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
He dwells close at hand, and sees all,
but how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin bhai paiai bhagat na hoee ||
lines.translation: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship.
Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, eternal peace is attained. ||1||
Such is the spiritual wisdom, the treasure of the Naam;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh paavas ras ras maan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: obtaining it, the Gurmukhs enjoy the subtle essence of this nectar. ||1||Pause||
Everyone talks about spiritual wisdom and spiritual knowledge.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kath kath baad kare dukh hoee ||
lines.translation: Talking, talking, they argue, and suffer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kath kahanai te rahai na koee ||
lines.translation: No one can stop talking and discussing it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin ras raate mukat na hoee ||2||
lines.translation: Without being imbued with the subtle essence, there is no liberation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan dhiaan sabh gur te hoee ||
lines.translation: Spiritual wisdom and meditation all come from the Guru.
Through the lifestyle of Truth, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਥਨੀ ਹੈ ਪਰੁ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh kathanee hai par rahat na hoee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh talks about it, but does not practice it.
Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest. ||3||
Maya has caught the mind in the trap of the whirlpool.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat biaap rahio bikh naal ||
lines.translation: Each and every heart is trapped by this bait of poison and sin.
See that whoever has come, is subject to death.
Your affairs shall be adjusted, if you contemplate the Lord in your heart. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so giaanee jin sabad liv laaee ||
lines.translation: He alone is a spiritual teacher, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.
The self-willed, egotistical manmukh loses his honor.
The Creator Lord Himself inspires us to His devotional worship.
He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||5||
The life-night is dark, while the Divine Light is immaculate.
Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are false, filthy and untouchable.
The Vedas preach sermons of devotional worship.
Listening, hearing and believing, one beholds the Divine Light. ||6||
The Shaastras and Simritees implant the Naam within.
The Gurmukh lives in peace and tranquility, doing deeds of sublime purity.
The self-willed manmukh suffers the pains of reincarnation.
His bonds are broken, enshrining the Name of the One Lord. ||7||
Believing in the Naam, one obtains true honor and adoration.
Who should I see? There is none other than the Lord.
I see, and I say, that He alone is pleasing to my mind.
Says Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||1||
